label: rem:cemetery-group-remark
title: The cemetery group is emergent
html:
The objects of the cemetery group are the homologically acyclic complexes. Physically, these are the decoupled or non-observable interaction channels.

The cemetery group is emergent. It is defined as the kernel of \tau rather than postulated. One uses \mathcal{Z}_n computationally as a homological filter on crystal-graph traversals.
